main.סמל_ארץ: chart-blocks, chart-codes, kpi:total, kpi:net, insight:blocks, insight:codes, insight:changes, table:historical — the unique key; its range gives the regional block
main.שם_ארץ: chart-blocks, kpi:countries, insight:general, insight:islands, insight:former, table:general, table:changed — general codes are detected from the name
main.ארץ_באנגלית: kpi:historical, insight:historical, insight:eng, table:historical, table:changed — historical entities are tagged only while the English name still matches
snapshot.טבלה: skip: constant label of the old file layout (טבלת ארצות); used only to select the old files
snapshot.שם_ארץ: table:changed — Hebrew renames since the earlier file
snapshot.ארץ_באנגלית: table:changed — English-name changes since the earlier file
